PreInvocation.command: R="${PWD}"; F="$R/hooks/fetch-bin.sh"; if [ -f "$F" ]; then exec sh "$F" ensure SessionStart; fi

hooks.command: R="${PWD}"; B="$R/bin/feov-pretooluse"; if [ -x "$B" ] || [ -x "$B.exe" ]; then exec "$B"; fi; F="$R/hooks/fetch-bin.sh"; if [ -f "$F" ]; then exec sh "$F" hook PreToolUse; fi
R="${PWD}"; B="$R/bin/feov-posttooluse"; if [ -x "$B" ] || [ -x "$B.exe" ]; then exec "$B"; fi; F="$R/hooks/fetch-bin.sh"; if [ -f "$F" ]; then exec sh "$F" hook PostToolUse; fi
